title: Restore drills lose every write made after the last backup

observation.summary: Demonstration 2's restore drill for Client A restored the backup intact but lost 3 writes made after it (rpo_lost_writes 3 against a proposed target of 0). The drill has no log shipping, so any write after the last backup is lost by design.
observation.kind_of_record: Reusable method (drill design). The target itself is a hypothesis Fixture Co proposed, not a commitment.

hypothesis: Shipping the SQLite write-ahead log to the backup folder between backups would bring lost writes to 0 in the crash drill. Untested: no patch exists yet.

thresholds.original: rpo_lost_writes reaches 0 in the crash drill
thresholds.regression: every hosting restore eval still passes

promotion.mechanism: git in the repository that holds the skills
promotion.command: the hosting fleet writes the patch and cases, then fleet improve pin and evaluate

rollback.command: not applicable until a patch exists

monitor.signal: rpo_lost_writes above 0 in the crash drill
